description.en: Python for building and deploying AI-powered business and cybersecurity apps: Python essentials, vibe coding with GenAI, pretrained and finetuned NLP models, and shipping with GitHub and Streamlit Cloud.
description.zh: 用 Python 做并上线 AI 驱动的商业与网络安全应用：Python 基础、用生成式 AI 辅助编程 (vibe coding)、预训练与微调的 NLP 模型，以及用 GitHub + Streamlit Cloud 部署。
